versions.changelog:
guaikei-extract-video-text v1.0.0

- Initial release: Extracts clean text and ready-to-use copy from video or audio files (supports online links and local files).
- Automatically removes filler words, mistakes, and repetitions, providing polished transcripts.
- Supports custom prompts for summaries, rewriting, highlights extraction, shot breakdowns, translation, etc.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN setup for access; supports various content extraction scenarios (summaries, scripts, meeting notes, creative rewriting).
- Designed for easy integration; modern, privacy-focused, cloud-based video/audio transcription.
